title: Vinton County linked sexual-abuse prosecution — Investigation One

data.case_name: Vinton County linked sexual-abuse prosecution — Investigation One
data.court: Vinton County Court of Common Pleas
data.case_type: criminal — rape, gross sexual imposition, sexual battery, and child endangering
claims: Josh Saunders was indicted on three counts of rape (F1) and one count of gross sexual imposition (F3).

Brandon Henderson Sr. was indicted on one F2 child-endangering count, two F3 child-endangering counts, four F3 gross-sexual-imposition counts, four F4 gross-sexual-imposition counts, eight F4 sexual-battery counts, and two M1 child-endangering counts.

docket_entries.description: Ohio Attorney General-origin reporting states that a Vinton County grand jury returned the listed charges against Josh Saunders and Brandon Henderson Sr. in the investigation opened in December 2025.
